content.value_statement: Document conversion teams need a practical way to judge whether HTML still matches a source PDF. This skill defines an AI-assisted visual review gate with scoring, explanations, and pass or fail guidance.
actual_capabilities: Compares rendered HTML screenshots against original PDF page images using an AI visual review workflow.
Scores layout, visual hierarchy, content positioning, and typography with weighted criteria.
Produces pass or fail recommendations against a configurable 85 percent threshold.
Defines a report format with differences, confidence, explanation, and criteria scores.
Supports multi-page chapter review through key page comparison and averaged scores.
limitations: It is documentation for a workflow, not a packaged executable validator.
Results depend on the selected vision model and screenshot quality.
It does not provide pixel-perfect comparison or deterministic visual diffs.
It assumes callers can render HTML and provide PDF page images.

use_cases.title: Review Converted Chapters
use_cases.description: Check whether generated chapter HTML preserves the layout and hierarchy of source PDF pages before release.

use_cases.title: Gate Visual Quality
use_cases.description: Use an explainable score threshold to stop a document conversion pipeline when visual accuracy drops.

use_cases.title: Compare Design Revisions
use_cases.description: Evaluate whether CSS changes improve readability without losing the original document structure.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare my rendered HTML screenshot with the original PDF page image. Report the overall score, major differences, and pass or fail recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Chapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare key pages from this HTML chapter against their original PDF images. Average the scores and summarize recurring layout issues.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Conversion Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill after CSS changes to compare the new rendered HTML screenshots with the original PDF pages. Highlight regressions in hierarchy, spacing, and typography.

prompt_templates.title: Design A CI Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to define an AI visual accuracy gate for a document conversion pipeline. Specify inputs, scoring weights, report fields, and failure handling.

output_examples.input: A rendered HTML page screenshot and the matching original PDF page image.
output_examples.output: The report gives a high similarity score, notes minor spacing differences, and recommends passing the page.

output_examples.input: A chapter with several rendered HTML screenshots and matching PDF page images.
output_examples.output: The review summarizes per-page scores, identifies repeated heading alignment issues, and recommends changes before approval.

output_examples.input: A new CSS revision for an existing converted document.
output_examples.output: The assessment compares the revision against the source PDF and flags typography changes that reduce visual fidelity.

best_practices: Use consistent screenshot dimensions for the original PDF page and rendered HTML output.
Review the written differences before accepting a borderline pass score.
Keep the threshold stable across similar documents to support comparable results.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the AI score as a substitute for checking missing content.
Do not lower the threshold to pass known visual regressions without review.
Do not compare screenshots captured at different zoom levels or page widths.

faq.question: Does this skill run a visual comparison tool by itself?
faq.answer: No. It describes the workflow, prompts, scoring criteria, and report format for an AI-assisted review.

faq.question: What files does the workflow expect?
faq.answer: It expects generated HTML, a rendered HTML screenshot, and the original PDF page image for comparison.

faq.question: What score is considered passing?
faq.answer: The documented default threshold is 85 percent, but teams can choose a different threshold.

faq.question: Can it handle multi-page chapters?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends comparing key pages, scoring each page, and averaging results for the chapter.

faq.question: Is this a pixel-perfect comparison?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on visual intent, readability, layout, hierarchy, positioning, and typography.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.
